name: Behari Lal Engineering Ltd.
summary: Behari Lal Engineering Ltd. engages in the business of manufacturing and trading of iron and steel products. Its products include ingot, steel casting, metal rolls, and alloy and non-alloy round, flat, hex, and square. The company was founded by Parkash Chand Garg on May 23, 1995 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
